CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Summer-2026 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Summer-2026 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 4,107 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 8 benchmark sites in 2 regions spanning 2 states (survey period: January 2026 to February 2026). These surveys captured 537 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 11 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 1,298 cards across 80 sites, with 7.6% showing evidence of mouse activity (99 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 232 transects across 67 sites (survey period: December 2025 to February 2026), detecting active burrows in 15.9% of transects (total: 76 active burrows).
